_doc: Indicator list used by tools/validate_evidence.mjs and rendered as INDICATORS.md. Statements are copied from the ledger phase files (method v4.2). Road = the road whose likelihood the indicator updates; I-N-* set the R1 'holders' attribute (how many independent controllers of frontier AI), I-TF-* set the R1 'narrow masters' lane (technofeudal sub-risk). Changing a statement is a method change (semver bump + CHANGELOG).

indicators.statement: >= 90% of training compute of the 10 largest known 2027 training runs belongs to organisations headquartered in the two leading jurisdictions (Epoch AI; snapshot 2028-03-31)
A government in a top-3 compute jurisdiction takes equity, a golden share or a formal priority-access security partnership with a top-5 frontier developer (by 2027-12-31)
>= 2 of the top-3 compute jurisdictions publish new or expanded controls on AI chips, chip tools or model weights (official gazettes; calendar 2027)
No agreement between the two leading compute jurisdictions sets verifiable limits on training compute or capabilities (official readouts, treaty texts; by 2028-06-30)
Combined FY2027 capex of the 5 largest AI/cloud spenders >= 1.2x FY2026 (securities filings; on FY2027 filings)
Relative employment index of ages 22-25 in the most AI-exposed occupation quintile falls >= 5 pts from its 2026 level (Stanford Digital Economy Lab 'Canaries' series, last 2027 release)
Share of firms using AI to produce goods or services >= 2x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census Bureau BTOS, 2027Q4)
Frontier 50%-success task time horizon >= 16 h (METR measurements, cross-checked against government AISI reports; by 2027-12-31)
A top-10 economy legally authorises fully automated decisions (no human sign-off) in a new benefits, tax or immigration domain (official gazette; OECD.AI; by 2028-12-31)
Recent-graduate unemployment minus the all-worker rate >= 2.0 pp in any 2027 quarter (NY Fed College Labor Market, 2027 quarterly)
An AI incident with >= USD 1bn damage or >= 100 deaths is officially attributed to AI (OECD AIM; government statements; by 2027-12-31)
A top-5 developer publicly halts frontier training >= 30 days, citing safety (developer announcement + independent confirmation; by 2027-12-31)
A top-3 compute jurisdiction has licensing or pre-approval of frontier training above a compute threshold in force (official gazette; by 2028-12-31)
An international body gains inspection or compute-verification powers covering >= 2 of the top-5 compute jurisdictions (treaty text, official gazettes; by 2029-12-31)
A mandatory registry of large training clusters (or chip-location tracking) operates in >= 2 of the top-3 jurisdictions (official gazettes; by 2028-12-31)

An AI system is documented to have copied itself or persisted outside its intended environment without authorisation, uncontained for >= 24 h (developer post-mortem or government report; by 2027-12-31)
A developer system card or government AISI evaluation reports a model at the developer's highest published autonomy or AI-R&D risk tier (by 2027-12-31)
A top-5 developer weakens or withdraws a published safety-framework commitment, documented by a text diff (framework documents, archived; calendar 2027)
Largest known training run >= 5e27 FLOP (Epoch AI; by 2027-12-31)
A top-5 developer reports AI systems did >= 50% of code or experiments in a frontier training project (technical report or system card; by 2028-12-31)
>= 15 distinct organisations with a >= 1e26 FLOP run (shared with I-N-01; counted once per family) (Epoch AI; 2027-12-31)
indicators.note: Merged with I-N-01 (counted once; I-N-01 canonical).

indicators.statement: The best open-weight model reaches the frontier score of 6 months earlier (Epoch Capabilities Index; rolling; 2027-12-31)
>= 20% of announced >100 MW AI data-centre capacity is outside the two leading jurisdictions (Epoch data-centre tracker; IEA; 2027)
Price of inference at fixed capability falls >= 10x from 2026 to 2027 (Epoch / AI Index price series; 2027 annual)
No top-3 compute jurisdiction bans or licenses open-weight release at the frontier tier (official gazettes; by 2028-06-30)
Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
Combined capex of the 5 largest spenders falls year on year for 2 consecutive quarters (securities filings; by 2028-06-30)
The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; resolves 2028-01)
BTOS AI-use share in 2027Q4 is < 1.5x its 2025 average (Bloc A Census BTOS; 2027Q4)
Global data-centre electricity use in 2027 is below the IEA's 2025 base-case projection for 2027 (IEA; 2028 release)
>= 15 distinct organisations have a training run >= 1e26 FLOP (Epoch AI, snapshot 2027-12-31)
Organisations with a training run >= 1e26 FLOP are headquartered in >= 4 jurisdictions (Epoch AI, snapshot 2027-12-31)
Labour share (nonfarm business, 4-quarter average) in 2027 is >= 1 pp below 2025 (BLS Productivity & Costs, Q4 2027 release)
Top-1% wealth share at 2027Q4 >= 2025Q4 + 1 pp (Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts, 2027Q4 release)
Median per-capita disposable income growth < mean growth in 2027 annual data (national statistics office; one indicator per leading jurisdiction)
A top-3 compute jurisdiction legislates guaranteed public access to frontier AI, or an AI dividend or sovereign fund paid to citizens (official gazette, by 2028-12-31)
